en.answer: In that case, <<16751>> itself cannot be returned to the Deck. As a result, the activation is not negated, and the card in question is not destroyed.
en.question: The effect of <<16751>> that negates an activation has been activated. What happens if <<16751>> itself no longer exists in the Monster Zone when that effect resolves?
en.title: What happens if <<16751>> itself no longer exists on the field when its effect resolves?

ja.answer: その場合、『このカードを持ち主のデッキに戻し』の処理を行えませんので、『その発動を無効にし破壊する』処理も行われません。
